ValidationRule.description: Only the value related to the case's Email outbox value is allowed in the email's from field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, NOT(CONTAINS(Text(Parent.SER_Outbound_Mailbox__c), FromName)), FromAddress <> $User.Email, FromName <> "BBVA Customer Service", FromName <> "BBVA NetCash Responde", FromName <> "Email OPINATOR" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Incorrect From value, only the value related to the case's Email outbox value is allowed.
